completionStandard.editorRoundTrip: Editor can create, edit, save, close, and reopen the data.
completionStandard.runtimeConsumption: Runtime loads and executes the editor-produced artifact.
completionStandard.explicitDiagnostics: Failures produce actionable diagnostics and never silently fall back.
completionStandard.versionedMigration: Persisted formats have a version, migrations, and round-trip tests.
completionStandard.platformMatrix: Required desktop and web rendering backends behave consistently.
completionStandard.automatedTests: The operation has automated acceptance coverage.
completionStandard.cleanMachine: Packaged artifacts pass an artifact-only clean-machine test.
completionStandard.productionReady: Production paths contain no simulation, placeholder, no-op, or fake success.

stages.name: CI, tests, and editor release foundation
Blueprint single source and runtime loop
Shared process and background task services
Build, publish, and real Web build
Undo, asset references, migrations, and hot reload
Full matrix tests, documentation, packaging, and release

features.summary: Machine-readable ownership and acceptance ledger for every registered editor panel, interactive editor source, and known production-debt marker.
blockers: Interactive action ownership is enforced at source-file granularity; stable per-action IDs are not yet available.
Asset formats and runtime consumers are declared but not yet auto-discovered from registries.
The final release Go/No-Go gate exists, but cannot pass until all later stages and production debt are closed.

features.summary: Build, test, package, verify, and publish editor artifacts.
blockers: No artifact-only clean-machine editor acceptance job.
Editor release acceptance does not execute all three Windows RHI backends.

features.summary: UI-independent DTOs, versioning, migration, diagnostics, and round-trip rules shared by editor and runtime content systems.
blockers: All six content formats (.dbp/.dasm/.dsequence/.dcutscene/.dshadergraph/.dscriptmeta) now share the single dse::assets::AssetDiagnostics DTO, the common NoteForwardCompat() version policy, and a shared field-level {version,...} envelope reader/writer (engine/core/asset_version_envelope.h: ReadVersionEnvelope records source_version + applies forward-compat and returns the parsed version; WriteVersionEnvelope emits the version field). All rapidjson-based serializers were converged onto it (blueprint/asm/cutscene/shadergraph/scriptmeta), each format still owning its own kXxxSchemaVersion and format-specific migration. Remaining: a single unified DTO layer/body schema across formats (each format still hand-rolls its own field-level body read/write) is a larger architectural refactor, not yet done.

features.summary: Blueprint editor, versioned asset, compiler, VM, debugger, lifecycle events, and runtime component execution.
blockers: Compiler now covers arithmetic/comparison/logical/Vec3/array nodes with unknown data nodes routed through CallExtern (no silent 0.0f fallback), and bytecode validation exists; full node-registry parity and lifecycle-event acceptance are still not covered.

Headless end-to-end acceptance now covers author->save(.dbp on disk)->reopen->compile->validate->VM execute via the shared serialize/compile/VM path (blueprint_lifecycle_e2e_test.cpp), asserting the authored logic produces the expected runtime value after a full disk round-trip. Live in-editor session E2E and hot-reload state migration are still not covered.

features.summary: Editor window, ImGui, viewport, and presentation paths on OpenGL, D3D11, and Vulkan.
blockers: OpenGL and Vulkan editor smoke cannot currently pass on the Windows validation environment.
No packaged clean-machine three-backend acceptance.

features.summary: Legacy Visual Script implementation removed after confirming no persisted production asset format existed.
Panel ownership, lifecycle, availability, menu registration, persistence, and generic dispatch.
blockers: editor_core_isolation integration acceptance is not yet a required gate.

features.summary: Argument-safe cross-platform process execution and cancellable editor background tasks.
blockers: All synchronous shell-outs go through the shared RunProcess (Git, Web/C# build, and the dse_cli dist packaging path: powershell/zip/tar/iscc + shell-free PATH lookup).

The shared engine/platform/process.{h,cpp} now also provides an async managed-process API (ManagedProcess: start->Running/WriteStdin/ReadStdout/TryGetExitCode/Wait/Kill/Pid, move-only with destructor tree-cleanup; Windows job-object + inherited-pipe + CREATE_NO_WINDOW, POSIX process-group + non-blocking pipes) plus a LaunchDetached() helper. All three remaining editor spawns were migrated onto it with explicit argument arrays (no shell string concat): editor_agent_panel (bidirectional stdin/stdout bridge, provider config passed as child env), editor_plugin_manager (managed child kept for later Kill()/PollStatus), and editor_external_editor (detached GUI-editor launch with a quote-aware arg tokenizer). Covered by 6 new ManagedProcess unit tests (stdout capture, bidirectional stdin/stdout, Kill, destructor cleanup, start-failure, detached error).
Cancellable long-running editor background-task acceptance and real agent-bridge/plugin end-to-end runs still require a live editor session and are not part of the headless gate.

features.summary: Repository discovery, status, diff, stage, commit, branches, fetch, pull, push, merge, and conflict actions.
blockers: E2E integration tests for fetch/pull/push/merge/conflict now pass (10/10) using temporary bare-remote repos.
Credential and authentication diagnostics are not accepted on a clean machine.

features.summary: Shared native and Emscripten configure, build, artifact collection, distribution, logging, and cancellation.
blockers: Unified BuildService (engine/project/build_service.h) provides a single RunGameBuild entry point shared by editor and CLI; 14 unit tests pass covering validation, engine-root detection, runtime-exe discovery, and build dispatch.
No artifact-only browser acceptance for editor-produced WebGL2 and WebGPU output.

features.summary: Versioned shader graph editing, validation, cross-backend compilation, material integration, and runtime loading.
blockers: Backend-agnostic codegen now emits five source profiles from the shared .dshadergraph schema via one node traversal: GLSL 430 (OpenGL), HLSL SM5 (D3D11), GLSL 450 (Vulkan, explicit layout/binding + UBO-wrapped uniforms), GLSL ES 3.00 (WebGL2), and WGSL (WebGPU, @group/@binding resources + struct I/O + textureSample). Nodes needing WGSL-specific lowering (Normal Map multi-component swizzle assignment, Rotate UV comma-declaration, Noise Voronoi C-style loop) warn + emit a safe default instead of invalid WGSL.

GenerateSpirv() compiles the Vulkan GLSL 450 output to REAL SPIR-V headlessly via the vendored glslang (linked into dse_engine under DSE_HAS_GLSLANG), and GenerateDxbc() compiles the HLSL SM5 output to REAL DXBC via d3dcompiler (VSMain vs_5_0 + PSMain ps_5_0; no GPU required, Windows+D3D11 build). Unit tests assert valid SPIR-V (magic 0x07230203) and a valid DXBC container ('DXBC' fourcc) for vertex+fragment, and that an invalid graph yields neither, so the Vulkan and D3D11 profiles are now compiler-validated rather than only string-contract-tested.

The WebGL2 (GLSL ES 300) and WGSL (WebGPU) profiles are now compiler-validated too: the generated vertex+fragment sources were compiled in real GPU-API contexts — WebGL2 via Chrome's ANGLE (shader compile + program link) and WGSL via createShaderModule()+getCompilationInfo() on a real WebGPU device (Deno/wgpu D3D12 WARP software adapter), both PASS. This validation caught and fixed a real bug: the GLSL ES header emitted a leading // comment before #version, which WebGL2/ANGLE strictly rejects ('#version directive must occur on the first line'); codegen now emits #version as the first line for all GLSL profiles, guarded by the GlslVersionDirectiveIsFirstLine unit test. Remaining: no in-editor rendered preview or screenshot-golden acceptance.

Editor exposes Export HLSL/Vulkan/WebGL2/WebGPU/SPIR-V/DXBC via the shared codegen, and the editor's live GLSL preview/compile/Apply-to-Material path is now unified onto the same shared codegen (the ~540-line editor-local GLSL emitter was removed). Remaining: no in-editor rendered preview or screenshot-golden acceptance.

features.summary: Persistent state machine and blend tree editing connected to runtime animator evaluation.
blockers: Versioned .dasm serialization, scene round-trip, and shared runtime transition selection/trigger consumption exist with unit and integration tests.
No full end-to-end acceptance with a real .danim asset and GPU skinned pose, and editor-preview vs runtime frame-equivalence is unverified.

features.summary: Persistent timeline, tracks, bindings, preview, cutscene runtime playback, and packaging.
blockers: Editor no longer loads demo data; .dsequence serialize/deserialize is extracted to a pure headless-tested core with 31 round-trip tests covering all track types, clips, keyframes, bindings, and corrupt-JSON diagnostics. Editor UI round-trip (open .dsequence, verify tracks/keyframes display, save, reopen) still needs manual/recorded verification.

Editor bake path uses the shared cutscene_serialize for .dcutscene export; SequenceFromRuntime provides the inverse mapping, but editor preview and runtime binding of packaged cutscene assets are not yet end-to-end verified.

features.summary: C# project generation, build, diagnostics, component binding, lifecycle, hot reload, persistence, and packaging.
blockers: Real dotnet build runs via the shared process service, hot reload uses a collectible AssemblyLoadContext for real unload/reload/rediscovery, and CSharpScriptComponent scene+prefab persistence is tested.
No real hostfxr/CoreCLR end-to-end that runs an actual game assembly (Play-mode init, ALC unload reclamation, clean-machine SDK run).

features.summary: All visible 2D, animation, terrain, navigation, asset, scripting, plugin, and auxiliary tools.
blockers: 2D tools (slicer, atlas, animation, 9-slice, collision, particles) now have 18/18 integration tests covering grid slicing, padding, offset, save/load round-trip, play/stop state, collision shape creation, and particle config defaults.
Most editor-local formats lack shared versioned runtime contracts and migrations.
There is no golden-project acceptance suite covering every visible operation.

features.summary: Crash capture, breadcrumbs, atomic multi-document autosave, recovery selection, and cross-platform safety.
blockers: Autosave now performs an all-or-nothing multi-document transaction across every dirty open scene tab: AutoSaveManager::Tick collects each dirty tab (active tab from the live registry, inactive tabs from their snapshots via SceneTabManager::CollectDirtyTabsForAutoSave) and commits them through editor_autosave_core AtomicWriteAll (stage every document to a sibling .tmp, then commit renames only if all writes succeeded; any write failure rolls back and leaves every final file untouched, so no partial/truncated content is ever committed). Live multi-tab autosave/recovery acceptance still needs a running editor session.
POSIX signal handler is now async-signal-safe (sigaction + write + _exit + backtrace_symbols_fd); verified to compile on Windows.

Recovery now enumerates every recoverable document (CollectRecoveryFiles) and the recovery dialog steps through and recovers/discards each one (document N of M); per-document schema validation before load and live multi-tab recovery acceptance still pending.

features.summary: Unified undo transactions, GUID references, dependency updates, format migration, and safe hot reload across every content system.
blockers: Undo system has 21/21 integration tests covering PropertyChangeCommand, LambdaCommand, CompoundCommand, UndoRedoManager (execute, undo, redo, merge, trim, clear, history queries, empty-stack edge cases, compound-in-manager).
AssetDatabase provides GUID-based lookup (FindByGUID/FindByPath) with .meta file generation; remaining gap is full content-type coverage.
Hot reload is not real for all supported script and plugin types.

features.summary: Long-running editor and runtime stability, leak checks, performance budgets, repeated reload, and Play/Stop acceptance.
blockers: Stability suite has 6/6 tests covering repeated undo/redo cycles (10 cycles × 100 cmds), large history trim (500→50), compound command cycling, performance budgets (1000 cmds < 100ms), and interleaved operations.
No accepted three-RHI leak and repeated hot-reload budget.

features.summary: Artifact-only full platform matrix, golden projects, documentation, manifests, packaging, and Go/No-Go release.
blockers: Release matrix validation has 10/10 tests verifying feature ledger, editor command vocabulary, undo system API, BuildService API, CrashHandler API, GitClient API, AssetDatabase API, 2D tools API, and CI/release workflow presence.
Release does not validate the full matrix from downloaded artifacts on clean machines.
Go/No-Go cannot pass while production-debt entries remain.
